title: E1AP: Dissect E1AP over TCP with a 4 byte length indication.

notes.body: TCP being a stream oriented protocol, you should use tcp_dissect_pdus() with this 4 bytes header to get the size of the message otherwise this dissection will likely fail.

Hi,
Sure if a pdu ever spans more than a single segment. I'll look at an update.
Regards
Anders

Hi Anders,

See !1771 for a proposal.
